## What the hard filters exist for

Before them, the matcher's top suggestions on this kind of run were mostly look-alikes: the other team, another stat line, a different threshold, date or direction, or identical text for a different game. Each of those is now a regression test (`tests/test_cup_match_regressions.py`). A missed match costs a trade; a wrong match costs money, so the filters trade recall for precision and the desk lets you map any market by hand.
